QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Package
QuestInfo.1: Find #t4032803#, which was taken by the monsters, and bring it to #bCassandra#k. You wonder what Cassandra requested from Gold Richie...
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the item to Cassandra.

0.0: Oh, you found all the items! We have no time to spare. Are you ready for the next task?

1.0: A package for me? Ahh, the item I requested from Gold Richie must have finally arrived. Thank you for delivering it to me... Now I'll be able to help the Resistance in Edelstein.

yes.0: Thank you. Why don't you take a break before you leave?
